limits: The components are frozen diagnostic fields rather than additional equilibria. A normal or tangential component in registry space is not a spatial direction on the image. Blending wall cores and surroundings does not impose force balance at the blend. All comparisons are retrospective and the two rings share the same acquisition.
scope: Add the periodic-minus-isolated registry correction either along the slip or perpendicular to it, and either inside or outside nominal wall-core radii of 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 nm. Use frozen material inputs and the same chord, detector, probe and per-model position fit. Compare with the original isolated wall and the full periodic network. Report the apparent width difference in the synthetic profiles and the held-out intensity profile error.
